note: The release of each app that install.mjs fetches and deploys: a git tag or commit, so a client install is the same code every time and a later push to main does not change what a client runs (security review 15 Nov 2026, S.8). Move an app forward here deliberately, after its CI is green, and record the date. `node install.mjs --latest` ignores this file and takes each repo's main. tools/release-checks.mjs runs against these pins in CI: a pin that accepts a forged first save fails the build (penetration test 16 Nov 2026, PT-02).
